title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!!

title_en: In Freske, 1+1 apartment with ample space for sale!!!
description_en: Near Restaurant Freskut, 1+1 apartment for sale with ample space. The apartment with a gross area of ​​68.5 m2, net 59.3 m2 is located on the second residential floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor, which is distributed in the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a bedroom and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is North-East. The property is equipped with full mortgage documentation. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
